column1: # Curated module abbreviations. Everything else is derived by every build (docs/radix/schema-v2.md,
# „Short names“); a line here is for a form that is well known, that the owner named, or that a
# module's own page or events use. Tab-separated:
# match    a module number (5 digits), or /pattern/ over the module's title (RE2 syntax)
# program  a program id (079-82-2008), or empty for every program
# abbrev   2 to 10 characters without spaces; {n} is the title's series number (Roman
#          numerals become digits). A pattern line appends the rest of the title's designator.
# source   owner = the owner said so; page = the module's own page or events use it;
#          common = in common use at German universities
# note     free text
# A line is the module's first candidate, not a promise: it beats every derived candidate, but
# where another line's form contests it in a program, tier and priority decide, and the loser
# falls back to its derived candidates (owner, 2026-09-25: „dann machen wir die meta eben neu“).
# The form of an owner or common line is reserved in the whole catalog: no module of another
# head derives it (no other AuP, no MA but a master's thesis). A line that applies to no module
# (a module number the catalog lacks, a program without that module, a pattern that matches
# nothing an earlier line does not take) is logged by the build (build.abbrev_overrides_unused).
